name: Thoi Son orchard fruit
summary: The Thới Sơn orchard fruit Vietnam Tourism names is longan, rambutan, Hòa Lộc mango, and An Phước plum. You pick it and eat it in the garden, or buy it. A price was not printed.
origin: Cù lao Thới Sơn. Vietnam Tourism’s rural page names the four fruits in the orchards.
howToEat: Pick the fruit in the orchard and eat it there, or buy it to take. Vietnam Tourism also says to eat fruit with the ginger honey tea.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. A season for each fruit was not printed. The season is Check on arrival.
where: The orchards on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho.
seoDescription: Vietnam Tourism names longan, rambutan, Hòa Lộc mango, and An Phước plum to pick on Thới Sơn. The price is Check on arrival.
